question.problem:
Let $R=[1,7]\times [3,5]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)=11{x}^{2}+13{y}^{2}-9.$ Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}=\{{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}\},\,{P}_{2}=\{{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}\},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Given that the upper Riemann sum of $f$ with respect to $P$ is given by

$$
U(f,P)={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}\boxed{}\,Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}
$$

where $Δ{x}_{i}={x}_{i}-{x}_{i-1}$ and $Δ{y}_{j}={y}_{j}-{y}_{j-1},$ what is the missing expression in the double summation above?
question.worked_solution:
The upper Riemann sum is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}{M}_{ij}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\end{aligned}
$$

where ${M}_{ij}$ is the *maximum* value of $f$ in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$ 

We consider an arbitrary subregion ${R}_{ij}$ of the partition. This subregion lies between ${x}_{i-1}$ and ${x}_{i}$ over the $x$-axis and ${y}_{i-1}$ and ${y}_{i}$ over the $y$-axis, as shown below. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14226209/assets/88ffe30ae5401e00502b35d851b216768aad69bf94236561617adf23e1ce058f.png)

Notice that:

- $f(x,y)=11{x}^{2}+13{y}^{2}-9$ increases as $x$ increases on $[1,7],$ and

- $f(x,y)=11{x}^{2}+13{y}^{2}-9$ increases as $y$ increases on $[3,5].$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14226209/assets/67daa328cc6ae4cb37be386c327fb4548844fad2adc10476bdf1147c5a5d4218.png)

As a result, the *maximum* value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the *largest* possible $x$ and the *largest* possible $y.$ This is the value at the *top right corner* of each subregion. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14226209/assets/6e58954fccd74eaf67c95df818c4c9050c35b324c5fffe4902a366cb295b8845.png)

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{ij} & =f({x}_{i},{y}_{j})=11{x}_{i}^{2}+13{y}_{j}^{2}-9\end{aligned}
$$

for all $1\le i\le m$ and $1\le j\le n.$

Finally, the upper Riemann sum is 

$$
\begin{aligned}U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}(11{x}_{i}^{2}+13{y}_{j}^{2}-9)Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the missing expression is $11{x}_{i}^{2}+13{y}_{j}^{2}-9.$
